observation: agent-loop 0.16.3 exposed three executable-UX failures during the consumer run: a delegated board ValidationException escaped as a raw PHP fatal, init scaffold produced a demo board with no archiveDirectory so its own demo card could not be archived, and workflow plan printed an unquoted Next command that the shell could not paste when the actor contained spaces/parentheses.

evidence.summary: A wrong delegated board flag produced an uncaught voku\AgentKanban\Exception\ValidationException stack trace instead of a normal umbrella CLI error.
agent-loop board card archive DEMO-1 failed because the scaffolded board had no archiveDirectory configured.
workflow plan printed an approve command containing an unquoted actor value with spaces and parentheses, so the displayed Next command was not shell-pasteable.

hypothesis: The umbrella emits or forwards CLI states without consistently guaranteeing that errors are normalized and suggested/scaffolded follow-up commands are executable.
validated_conclusion: The HTTPFUL-1 run showed that agent-loop 0.16.3 could turn ordinary CLI mistakes into fatals and could generate scaffold/Next states that its own subsequent commands could not execute as presented.
